connectionSpecification.description: Writes each stream into a typed table of one SQL Server 2016+ or Azure SQL database: overwrite, append or append_dedup.

database.description: The name of the database; it must exist.
database.title: DB Name

host.description: The host name of the database.
host.title: Host

password.description: The password associated with this username.
password.title: Password

schema.description: The schema every table is written to; created when missing.
schema.title: Default Schema

ssl_method.description: The encryption method which is used to communicate with the database.

oneOf.description: Data transfer will not be encrypted; only the login is, when the server supports encryption.
oneOf.title: Unencrypted

oneOf.description: Use the certificate provided by the server without verification. (For testing purposes only!)
oneOf.title: Encrypted (trust server certificate)

oneOf.description: Verify and use the certificate provided by the server.

certificate.description: PEM certificate of the CA that signed the server certificate. Empty: the CAs trusted by the connector image.
certificate.title: CA Certificate

hostNameInCertificate.description: The host name the server certificate must name. Empty: the configured host. Set it when the connector reaches the server by another name, such as an IP address.
hostNameInCertificate.title: Host Name In Certificate

oneOf.title: Encrypted (verify certificate)

ssl_method.title: SSL Method
